existing_rows_audit.detail: No req titled 'Trading Systems Engineer (Crypto)' exists on IMC's board. The matching role is 'Core Developer - Digital Assets' (https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4637267101), whose body text opens 'As a C++ Software Engineer' and covers the ultra-low-latency crypto trading platform. The Zug office is confirmed real (https://www.imc.com/eu/contact/offices). The row's eligibility note is also wrong: this req has NO graduation-year window and no years-of-experience minimum, only a Master's/PhD requirement. The 'CHF 140-220k' figure is not stated anywhere on the posting and I found no credible source for it.

The exact posted titles are 'Graduate Software Engineer (2026)' (https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4564480101) and 'Graduate Software Engineer (2027)' (https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4667814101) — there is no '(C++)' suffix; the req says 'Proficiency in C++ or Java is required'. Office and role both confirmed. The year-window gate in the row is accurate for THIS req ('ultimate year of study... joining Feb or Aug 2027'), but the row wrongly propagates that gate to the experienced reqs — the experienced Amsterdam C++ Software Engineer req is gated on '5+ years post-graduation' instead, not a graduation year. The '€90-140k' figure is not stated on the posting.

The Hong Kong office is confirmed (https://www.imc.com/eu/contact/offices) but there is no generic 'Software Engineer' req there. The only Hong Kong software engineering opening is 'Software Engineer - Tooling' (https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4931814101), whose stack is Python/Java/React/SQL, not C++ — so the row's C++ track assignment is misleading. The row's graduation-year gate is flatly wrong for this req, which states verbatim 'What you don't need: ... Experience in any particular language. A specific set of years in any particular role.' The 'HKD 1.4-2.0M' figure is not stated on the posting.

Out of scope for this pass — the brief excludes US offices, so I did not verify this row. For the record, IMC's board does carry Chicago C++ engineering reqs (e.g. 'C++ Software Engineer', Chicago/New York, https://www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/4673650101), so the office and role family exist, but the exact title, the '$350-425k' figure and the graduation-year gate were not checked.

notes:
Method: careers.imc.com 308-redirects to https://www.imc.com/eu/search-careers, which is a paginated JS listing (only 10 of 157 reqs render per fetch). IMC's board is hosted on Greenhouse, so I enumerated the complete live req set via the firm's own Greenhouse board API (https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/imc/jobs?content=true) — 157 open reqs on 2026-08-04, with full posting text for every one. Every role above was read from that primary content, so all are verified-primary; the URLs given are the firm-domain form (www.imc.com/eu/careers/jobs/<id>), which mirror the Greenhouse links (job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/imc/jobs/<id>).

Offices: IMC's own offices page (https://www.imc.com/eu/contact/offices) lists exactly ten cities — Amsterdam, Chicago, Sydney, Mumbai, London, Zug, Aarhus, Hong Kong, New York, Seoul. IMC has NO office in Singapore, Shanghai, Tokyo, Paris, Dublin, Frankfurt, Milan or Warsaw. Aarhus (Denmark) is a newer office the existing sheet does not cover at all and it is running a greenfield energy-trading build-out with an experienced-hire C++ req — that is the biggest coverage gap I found. Zug is Switzerland, not the EU, but I kept it in scope because the brief's work-authorisation section explicitly covers Zug under the candidate's CH residence permit.

Compensation: IMC states no salary figures on any European, UK or Hong Kong posting (their US postings do carry ranges, per US pay-transparency law, but those are out of scope). Every comp_local is therefore empty. The four figures in the existing spreadsheet rows are unsourced and should be treated as invented until someone finds a filing or levels.fyi datapoint.

Graduation-year gates: the existing sheet applies one blanket gate ('current student graduating Sep<y>-Jul<y+1>') to all four IMC rows. That is wrong. IMC runs three distinct gate types: (a) campus reqs in Amsterdam, Aarhus, London and Chicago with an explicit window ('ultimate year of study... joining Feb or Aug 2027') — genuinely closed to this candidate; (b) experienced reqs with a years-of-experience floor of 3+ or 5+; and (c) a handful of reqs with NO gate at all. The ungated ones are the actionable targets: Zug Core Developer - Digital Assets, Zug Graduate Software Engineer - Digital Assets (no year window stated, unlike its Amsterdam namesake), Amsterdam Performance Engineer, Hong Kong Research Engineer and Hong Kong Software Engineer - Tooling.

Exclusions and judgement calls: I dropped internships (all are 10-week summer programmes), working-student and work-integrated-master's positions, SRE/IT-ops, network and hardware engineering, and recruiting/risk/finance roles.
